config.title: Marketing
config.description: Plan content and manage ads across 100 global marketing channels.

permissions.label: Read organization marketing content and analytics
Read visits and conversions per campaign from the organization's Analytics projects
Create and update shared marketing plans, ads, budgets, and metrics
Read the organization's CRM and Zoho Mail sync to count email and closed deals and suggest emails to send
Read the member and online counts of the organization's connected Discord server
Read the last 6 days of posts in the channels chosen for the organization's Discord connector, without storing them
Read configured public channel feeds, profile statistics and App Store ratings from approved origins
Open configured channel profiles, published content, and ad consoles after an explicit click
Post to the organization's connected X account when an owner or admin presses Post
Follow suggested people from the organization's Mastodon account when an owner or admin presses Follow
Show this desktop's special agents on their channel pages, and open, run or message one when you press its button
Send campaign, channel and keyword summaries to ForkMesh AI when a member asks the Marketing agent for suggestions
